How Answer Index Pro Runs On Autonomous Autopilot

Zero terminal commands. Zero manual copywriting. From automated Search Console drift detection to scheduled draft delivery in your CMS or Git repository timed to your workflow.

The 4-Step Daily Autonomous Execution Routine

06:00 AM · SCAN & AUDIT

1. Search & AI Drift Discovery

The autonomous engine checks Google Search Console and simulates queries across ChatGPT Search and Perplexity to identify slipping rankings and unanswered buying prompts.

07:30 AM · VERIFICATION

2. Brand Truth Invariant Gate

Before drafting any text, the engine checks candidate claims against your Ground-Truth Wiki stored in Cloudflare D1. Zero hallucinated pricing or fabricated features are allowed.

CUSTOM SCHEDULE · DISPATCH

3. Dual-Job Staged Delivery

Two precision jobs are staged for review: Job 1 (New Answer Piece) and Job 2 (Technical SEO & Schema Patch) delivered directly to your platform.

YOUR TIME · APPROVAL

4. 1-Click Human Verification

Review live interactive previews in your WordPress draft queue, Web Portal, or GitHub Pull Request. One click publishes to live production with zero coding.
